Anza.name: Lorene Kellogg
Anza.text:
Had a hard time getting a well service to fix our well that was very, very slow..  Called some local companies that either did not return our calls or we heard from them to discuss the issue and then we couldn't reach them to finalize when they would do the work.  We were very frustrated after a month trying.

We then made one more attempt by contacting Southern California Well Service that we found online.  Someone called back right away - a real person.  They had a next day appointment.  They came at the scheduled time and pulled up the pipe and pump.  Said the pipe is still good.  Gave a quote that we agreed to and they honored the quote.  They replaced the pump and motor and put new fittings on the pipe and got the system up and running in about 5 hours.  This included their trip to get supplies.  They were very professional and we could pay by credit card online.  The system is now working great again.  We were happy and relieved to have our system working so well.

Anza.name: Jane Frank
Anza.text: The technician was excellent in troubleshooting our water problems with a complex well, reverse osmosis system, and water storage tank system. The technician methodically tested all variables in our system and was able to accurately identify that a solenoid in our RO system was not working properly. Once we had it replaced, the whole system is working properly. This has been an ongoing problem for months if not years, so thank you for finally finding the solution!

Ramona.name: Joyce Boysel (Joyful#1)
Ramona.text: Very timely and diagnosed and fixed the problem right away!

Ramona.name: Dennis Albert
Ramona.text:
I’m an early riser, and one recent morning at 5 a.m., I discovered that my well water had stopped working. The local company I’d used in the past was no longer in business. After searching online for a new service, I found Southern California Well Service—which, as it turns out, had actually acquired the old company.
I noted their phone number and email address, and since it was too early to call, I sent an email, planning to follow up after 8 a.m. To my surprise, I received a call from Southern California Well Service at 5:30 a.m.! We quickly scheduled an appointment.
Brian, the technician, kept me updated on his arrival time as he was delayed by issues at a prior job. Once he arrived, he quickly diagnosed the problem: a faulty capacitor. He had the replacement part on his truck, and within 20 minutes, the repair was complete. Power was restored, the pump was running properly, and water pressure returned to normal.
Southern California Well Service—and Brian in particular—exceeded my expectations. They were prompt, professional, and efficient. I highly recommend them!

Ramona.text: I've called on Southern Ca Well Service 3 times now for repairs to my well system.  Brighton is extremely knowledgeable and quick.  I have been impressed with the service every time.  I can't imagine going with anyone else for repair work.

Ramona.name: Tyler
Ramona.text: These guys are amazing professionals, who seemed to really care. They provided multiple options for a replacement pump based on my needs and were able to quickly install everything.

Ramona.name: Victor Trevino
Ramona.text: Great service. He was polite and got all my work done lower than the competitors. Willing to work with my needs and tells you the truth on what is best for your circumstances even if it means it’s him charging you less. He cares about the customer and cares about what he does.

Ramona.name: Deb Stanfill
Ramona.text: Finally, a responsive and friendly well service company.  We've lived on a property serviced by a well for over 25 years and have worked with several well drilling and service companies.  SC Well Service was a breath of fresh air.  1st, you actually get a call back.  Believe it or not, that is not the case most of the time.  Though, if you've had a well for some time, you already know this.  2nd, the rep you talk to, in our case Brighton, is friendly and helpful.  What???  Never, ever, have any of the other contractors even been above borderline rude.  They acted like they were doing us a favor by even talking to us.  3rd, they came out on time, as promised, and communicated when they were enroute.  Brighton spent time with us listening to the symptoms we reported and what we'd done in advance of calling him.  At this point, I was in shock.   He did his evaluation and scheduled the follow-up to pull the pump as we and he expected that was the problem.  The pumps aren't built to last 10 years any longer; 3 is about the norm now.  4th, they came out for the appointment to repair our system on time and again communicated with us on ETA.  They did the work, provided a detailed invoice (not the typical simple bill with very little information as to the pump/motor or other parts that were installed ), and they cleaned up.  Wow!!!  Love, love, love this company.  They are putting all other well contractors to shame.  Use them, you won't be sorry.

Alpine.name: Bill Swegles
Alpine.text: Our property in Alpine, California has three wells watering four landscaped acres.  Southern California Well Service has serviced our wells for five years.  Brighten and his crews have been honest, expert, thorough, prompt, and reasonably priced.  They always tell me how I can fix the problem and save money.  If something is under warranty, they know it and fix it at no charge.  This is the first well service company I've truly trusted.

We Got scheduled and a couple hours later they had identified the problem and were making repairs. I am so grateful to them for taking great care of me and my family. We appreciate them so much! If you have a well issue, you can definitely count on them.
